verdict.rationale: Docs show a large integrations directory ('hundreds of vendors', 'connect ... with just a few clicks'), plus forwarding rules, Consent Filters, and Data Privacy Controls that filter what data reaches which destination, and Feeds/Warehouse Sync API for mapping data. Community evidence (HN) independently corroborates that mParticle forwards data onward to many analytics providers simultaneously. missing for 10: a documented full catalog/list of destination names and per-destination field-mapping UI screenshots or detailed configuration docs beyond generic filter/consent examples.
